A serious complaint was lodged some time ago, yet there's been no meaningful update from the practice manager, Julie Walsh—just a generic acknowledgement. Meanwhile, staff are openly advising patients to "game the Anima system" just to get an appointment. This is unacceptable.

Here’s what patients are dealing with:

You request a medication review, get an appointment with a specific time, but no one calls. When chased, you’re told the call could come anytime between 9–5, so if you miss it, it’s somehow your fault. Call back within minutes? You’re told they’ll “try” to call back. Apparently working full time doesn't constitute a proper appointment time slot.

You expect one medication to be reviewed (as clearly stated in emails), but they review a different one.

You’re passed to someone who isn't qualified for your care needs—unable to do basic calculations to ensure you receive a full month’s supply of medication.

The medication that wasn’t meant to be reviewed gets changed—again—with incorrect dosages or insufficient quantity.

These same errors keep happening, over and over, with no accountability.

This practice is outdated, disorganised, and is causing actual harm through mismanagement. Patients deserve safe, competent care—not excuses and system failures.

If you’re a patient here, I strongly recommend writing to the Care Quality Commission and your MP.

This place either needs a full overhaul or to stop pretending it can function in the 21st century.",null,[0,136]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25WR2MxRmlTR0ZzYW5kT1puWm9UWGczV1RSVFNGRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xcb59327f4facbccd!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnVGc1FiSGFsandOZnZoTXg3WTRTSFE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25WR2MxRmlTR0ZzYW5kT1puWm9UWGczV1RSVFNGRRAB&t=1&_MlnLKgswY0ttckVEM05sWg&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi8ntKRr7CTAxXIEmMBHcs6IbYQoykIEygB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwi8ntKRr7CTAxXIEmMBHcs6IbYQ0pMFCBEoBQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMmh5WkZFMU4xOWZSV2hFUW14c1MxYzNjbUpSUkZaVGRVUm1XVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEprTkVOaFIzUXhSRzV6V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNSd29xMzhBRRAB",["0x0:0xcb59327f4facbccd",null,1680004173799666,1749211402288715,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/101464724191244511760/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Gilesyone","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXKjfRA0jswCvsQviPW6aaDId7XEUK1Tm-ApIgz2s8OUQi7wcA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/101464724191244511760?hl=en"],"101464724191244511760",null,19,5,null,[1,5,1],1,["Local Guide · 19 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi8ntKRr7CTAxXIEmMBHcs6IbYQ7LoGCBUoAA"]]]],null,"Edited 9 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["ZERO STARS NOT AN OPTION.
